checks.statement: The real raw-C fiber coefficient is exactly the declared A.
The relative factor has the declared lambda and kappa terms.
The exact first relative-factor derivative fixes the envelope coefficients.
The exact second relative-factor derivative fixes the envelope coefficients.
The declared Liouville-Green residual identity holds.
The residual has the audited A=A0*(1+delta) factorization.
The DLMF error-control integrand identity holds for positive A.
The lambda=kappa=0 residual baseline is exactly one quarter.
The lambda=kappa=0 control integrand is exp(-Q)/(24*pi^2).
The lambda=kappa=0 tail variation is exactly exp(-Q)/(24*pi^2).
The positive lambda envelope decreases on Q>=4.
The positive kappa envelope decreases on Q>=4.
The lambda corner is below its declared rational envelope.
The kappa corner is below its declared rational envelope.
The uniform relative-factor envelope is below eta_bar=1e-5.
The first-derivative envelope is at most 2 eta_bar.
The second-derivative envelope is at most 4 eta_bar.
A is uniformly positive on the declared real tail box.
The audited derivative envelopes yield R_bar algebraically.
R_bar is a conservative perturbation of the exact baseline residual.
The analytic tail variation is bounded by elementary V_bar.
The DLMF E_bar and normalized log-derivative-difference bounds are finite and below their declared smallness threshold.
